content: भैरव {%a.%} (-वी|{%f.%}) [भीरोरिदम् अण्] .²1 Terrible, frightful, horrible, formidable; वेल्लद्भैरवरुण्डमुण्डनिकरैर्वीरो विधत्ते भुवम् <ls>U. 5. 6</ls>. .²2 Miserable. .²3 Relating to Bhairava. .{@-वः@} .²1 A form of Śiva (of which 8 kinds are enumerated). .²2 The sentiment of terror (भयानक). .²3 Fear, terror. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a musical mode (राग) calculated to excite emotions of fear or terror. .²5 A mountain. .{@-वी@} .²1 A form of the goddess Durgā. ˚चक्रम् a disc of the goddess भैरवी; प्रवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे वर्णा द्विजोत्तमाः . निवृत्ते भैरवीचक्रे सर्वे वर्णाः पृथक् पृथक् .. <ls>Utpattitantra.</ls> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical system. .²3 A girl of 12 or a young girl representing the goddess Durgā at the Durgā festival. .{@-वम्@} Terror, horror.
